title: brutalist↔art-deco↔biophilic · 3-phase particle morph
concept: Three-phase click morph: Phase 1 BRUTALIST stacked setbacks (warm cement #a09080), Phase 2 ART-DECO tapered ornamental spire (bronze #7a5a2a), Phase 3 BIOPHILIC Gaudi branching canopy (deep green #2a5a2a). 60k particles LERP positions over 2s. No rotation between phases — each phase fully commits to its register.
